title: the Nehwon mythos
audit_comment: THE NEHWON MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round fifteen, print pp. 96-104, the Fritz Leiber section: twenty-nine stat-block rows - the four heroes (Fafhrd, the Gray Mouser, Movarl, Pulgh), the two wizards (Ningauble of the Seven Eyes, Sheelba of the Eyeless Face), the two greater gods (Death, Kos), the six lesser gods (the Gods of Trouble, Hate, the Nehwon Earth God, the Rat God, the Red God, Tyaa), the five demigods (Aarth, the Gods of Lankhmar, Issek of the Jug, the Spider God, Votishal) and ten monsters - plus the Lankhmar doctrine of the intro (the Thieves Guild, the Slayers' Brotherhood, the Snow Witches, the Fire Sorcerers of the East, the gems, the Cults of the Beast, the Godsland) and the six outdoor encounter tables of print p. 104 riding as the fifth grid (74 rows). THE HEADLINE ADJUDICATIONS: the QUARTER-FOOT DECODE - the Gray Mouser prints SIZE M (5 1/4 foot), the walk first quarter-cell, pinned 63 inches (the 1eonline voice reads 5.25'); Aarth the half-foot 5 1/2 print pinned 66. The DIVERGENT CELLS pinned by the 2nd-print extract with the L&L parity noted: Death AC -5 (L&L -4), the Gods of Trouble AC -2 (L&L -3, tsv-verified minus 2 at w22), Votishal HP 344 (L&L 244, the token confirmed on-page), Tyaa AC the bare-dash print pinned 0 (L&L -3, the w2 dash glyph) and Votishal AC the dash-minus pinned -2 (the Surma dash-token precedent). The ODD PRINTS pinned as printed: the Issek 12/12 dual move (both voices), the Hate printed 0 hit points, the Hate See below MU/I pair pinned 99/99 (the egp Isis precedent), the Hate dash W/C/CH ability cells pinned 0, Death the Infinite move minus-1 sentinel, the bird of Tyaa the 1/18 move split, Ningauble the Nil attacks, Sheelba the bare M (the R861 precedent), the Gods of Trouble the Special magic resistance pinned 0 with the 30-foot no-magic radius riding a const, the spider god the 15th level magic-users plural print, and the Devourer the Variable size sentinel. The monster XP romans verified against both voices: III/90+3 astral wolf, VIII/4,000+20 behemoth, II/30+1 bird, X/28,500 cold woman flat, II/50+3 ghoul, X/15,800+35 leviathan, VII/2,050+14 snow serpent, III/105+3 salt spider, III/150+4 water cobra. The encounter-table catches: the marsh Men-brigand 21-42 / Men-merchant 43-50 rows restored from the fold-garbled Termux voice via the L&L transcription, and the mountains overlap print (astral wolf 01-05, bird of Tyaa 03-06) pinned as printed. The psionic pipes: the class I of Death, the Gods of Trouble and the Rat God, the class V of the Gods of Lankhmar and Votishal, the class VI of the Nehwon Earth God and the Red God (the w10/w49 calibration). The fraction fingerprint rides the roster: the advisor rivalry pair of Ningauble and Sheelba (the mlb Elenoin-Grahuk precedent).

banner.title: the Nehwon mythos - the D&DG walk round fifteen, print pp. 96-104: twenty-nine stat-block rows - the four heroes Fafhrd and the Gray Mouser, Movarl and Pulgh; the two wizards Ningauble of the Seven Eyes and Sheelba of the Eyeless Face; the two greater gods Death and Kos; the six lesser gods (the Gods of Trouble, Hate, the Nehwon Earth God, the Rat God, the Red God, Tyaa); the five demigods (Aarth, the Gods of Lankhmar, Issek of the Jug, the Spider God, Votishal) and ten monsters (the Astral Wolf, the Behemoth, the Bird of Tyaa, the Cold Woman, the Devourer, the Nehwon Ghoul, the Leviathan, the Snow Serpent, the Salt Spider, the Water Cobra) - plus the Lankhmar doctrine and the six encounter tables of print p. 104.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 097-105; the second printing) with the tsv word geometry; the collation voice: the 1eonline Legends & Lore transcription (the R853 parity voice - the interior identical to the late D&DG prints) plus the tsv digit-glyph calibrations of the R859-R861 era. The adjudications: the Mouser quarter-foot 63 decode, the Aarth 3/2 attack split, the Death Infinite-move and the tsv minus 5 armor class, the Gods of Trouble w22 minus 2, the Tyaa w2 dash, the Votishal 344 token, the marsh-table fold restore, and the mountains overlap pinned as printed.
